steps.caption: Open Transactions and the Lumen Harbour Tech transaction.
Section 12, deposits: the security deposit is approved and due, but not paid.
Record payment: stage paid, the date and the evidence — the bank reference. Paid without evidence is refused.
Paid — acknowledgement still needs the landlord's receipt.
Section 13, Execution milestones: each one has its own date and evidence. Nothing is inferred from another.
Record 'commercially agreed' with today's date and the evidence.
Executed needs an executed agreement document. When it is recorded, the lease is handed to Leases automatically.
Section 14, Possession and fit-out: scope, contractor, dates, progress and approvals.
Section 15, Handover: generate the checklist when possession approaches.
Each item is open until closed with evidence. Add defects too — seepage near the pantry, for the landlord to fix.
Close an item with its evidence and who acknowledged it.
